# Third-party resources

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/oeo.py build from third_party/registry.yaml. Edit the source, then run `python3 scripts/oeo.py build`. -->

OEO bundles **no** third-party skill files. The resources below were evaluated and are
referenced as optional adapters: install them yourself through the upstream installer,
under the upstream license. OEO's router suggests them only when they are already
installed in your session. Runtime: OEO has no third-party runtime dependencies;
contributors need PyYAML (MIT), see `requirements-dev.txt` and `sbom.cdx.json`.

## Ideas adapted into OEO

Re-expressed in OEO's own words (no upstream text is copied). Credit to the upstream authors:

- **Everything Claude Code (ECC)** (MIT): oeo:chief-of-staff: four-tier triage applied in strict order, skip, info only, meeting info, action required; oeo:chief-of-staff: briefing layout puts schedule first, then action items, then stale pending replies
- **REA (Reverse Engineer Anything)** (MIT): oeo:research: tag every finding observed, inferred or unknown, each with its evidence source; oeo:research: pair each question with the evidence that would answer it, then recheck at the end; oeo:research: authorization gate first, no DRM or login bypass, no copying protected code or assets; oeo:research: when a full source repository exists, read it and skip reverse engineering
- **Paperclip** (MIT): oeo:deliver: every task carries its goal chain and a single owner; oeo:deliver: finish concrete work in the same pass and report status with a named blocker; oeo:finops: warn near 80% of budget, restrict to critical work, hard stop at 100%; oeo:chief-of-staff: promise only follow-ups that were actually scheduled, never an imaginary watcher
- **chief-of-staff skill (alirezarezvani/claude-skills)** (MIT): oeo:chief-of-staff: score a decision by counting risk factors, then pick one role or a board; oeo:chief-of-staff: board of at most five roles, one turn each, conflicts surfaced for the human; oeo:chief-of-staff: prevent loops with no self-invocation, shallow depth and no A to B to A calls; oeo:chief-of-staff: synthesize as themes, named conflicts, owned actions, one decision point with a review date
- **last30days** (MIT): oeo:research: resolve official handles and sites before searching, never a bare keyword; oeo:research: rank community signal by engagement, not search position, and prefer live counts; oeo:research: report each source's outcome state, so a failed source is never read as nothing found
- **i-have-adhd** (MIT): agent output style: lead with the doable action before any explanation; agent output style: restate progress every turn, such as step 3 of 5 done; agent output style: cap visible lists at five items per group, keep the rest retained; agent output style: before sending, cut preamble, recaps and hedges so first and last lines carry the point
- **PM Skills Marketplace** (MIT): oeo:business-review: keep the PRD lean, move unknowns to assumptions instead of writing TBD; oeo:business-review: red-team load-bearing claims, writing each failure as a 'Fails if' statement; oeo:business-review: pre-mortem sorts worries into tigers, paper tigers and elephants, each with an action; oeo:business-review: triage assumptions by impact times risk, test the top ones with behaviour experiments
- **Marketing Skills for AI Agents** (MIT): oeo:launch: one shared product-marketing context file that every later step reads first; oeo:launch: voice table plus a learnings log where lessons are retired, never deleted; oeo:launch: copy gate tests that a line is visible, falsifiable and not something competitors could say; oeo:launch: readiness gate before tactics, then phases and owned over rented channels
- **Awesome DESIGN.md** (MIT): oeo:design-direction: keep a DESIGN.md at the project root, the visual counterpart of AGENTS.md; oeo:design-direction: fixed section skeleton for colors, type, components, spacing, do/don't and responsive rules; oeo:design-direction: every do/don't names a token and gives its reason; oeo:design-direction: render a preview page so a human can check the extraction
- **Open Design** (Apache-2.0): oeo:design-direction: ask structured questions and lock a visual direction before generating anything; oeo:design-direction: tiered anti-slop checklist, must-fix items include invented metrics and filler copy; oeo:design-direction: review through designer, critic, accessibility and copy lenses, ship after bounded rounds; oeo:design-direction: roughly 80% proven patterns plus one deliberate distinctive move
- **Firecrawl for Claude** (MIT): oeo:research: escalate from search to scrape, map, crawl, and only then interactive browsing; oeo:research: save fetched pages to files and grep them instead of loading them into context; oeo:research: report truncated reads as partial coverage and separate excerpts from full text; oeo:finops: honor user credit caps and stop paid collection when the budget is unknown
- **Playwright CLI with agent skills** (Apache-2.0): oeo:verify: snapshot the page, act on element references, then snapshot again to confirm; oeo:verify: emulate color scheme, reduced motion and print, and inspect console and network; oeo:verify: a CLI plus skill costs fewer tokens than a persistent tool server for coding agents
- **playwright-skill (community)** (MIT): oeo:verify: detect running dev servers first and ask which one when several are found; oeo:verify: locate elements by role, label, text, then test id, with web-first assertions; oeo:verify: never claim success without checking the resulting page state
